name: Lyrquel
description: Few charts agree on Lyrquel, whose primary casts a hypergiant glare across the local dark. Old claim buoys tumble here, their registries expired and their owners gone. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

stars.name: Veiled Moth
stars.description: A hypergiant of 209.1 solar masses, unstable against the dark. One of the most luminous things in the sector, violent and brief. Long-baseline scopes watch it for the cycle that precedes its next active phase.

planets.name: Ironward
planets.description: Lava lakes breathe through a fractured crust, resurfacing yearly. The air itself is a hazard the suits filter with complaint. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

moons.name: Hollow Boulder III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

moons.name: Pale Slate V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

planets.name: The Pale moor
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Storm ovals larger than worlds spin for centuries without fading. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

planets.name: Umberbank
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Subsurface warmth is rumored, and twice confirmed, and never shared. Claim jumpers whisper about a world that charts itself differently every survey.

dwarfPlanets.name: Calm Minor 40
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

comets.name: Wandering Promise
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
